title: Textile passport
description: An explicit draft successor to textile@3 correcting the distinction between existing fibre-labelling duties, consumer-claim rules, application fields and future textile passport requirements. Component composition is assessed under Article 11. The revision does not establish full product qualification or a completed standards assessment; historical profile bytes remain unchanged.
regulatoryLine: Mapped to existing textile labelling and consumer-information sources, with textile-specific ESPR passport requirements still anticipated and source/application assessments explicit.

statements.text: Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 on textile fibre names and labelling is in force and is the source of the fibre composition and animal-origin declarations.
The ESPR delegated act for textiles has not been adopted; fields whose permitted form waits on it say so and state no list or pattern.

The Commission's textile and apparel product passport page, retrieved 6 September 2026, gives the textile delegated act an indicative adoption in the fourth quarter of 2027; every ESPR parameter field is anticipated until it is adopted, and its permitted form is not guessed.
This profile's alignment with the draft data requirements is under review.

Existing labelling and consumer-claim rules do not prescribe every application field. Component composition follows Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 1007/2011. Consumer-directive measures apply from 27 September 2026 subject to national transposition and their specific conditions.
